issue_label: COVID-19 Delay Deductibility — Ontario (Articulable Link Standard)

default_authority.principle: There is no rule that all periods of delay during the COVID-19 pandemic should be attributed to exceptional circumstances. The Crown must establish an articulable link between the specific delay period and the pandemic.
Delay must be attributable to the pandemic in some articulable sense. A general assertion of pandemic disruption is insufficient.
Articulable link standard reiterated as of 2026. Post-2021 pandemic-attributed delay faces heightened evidentiary burden as courts move further from acute closures.

notes: App must require user to specify: (a) specific period, (b) articulable link text field, (c) jurisdiction confirmation. Post-2021 Ontario COVID claims must display heightened evidentiary burden warning. COVID is a sub-type of discrete exceptional circumstances — not a parallel deduction stream.
